##### Project general facts

The St. Regis Residences is an extraordinary branded residential development that brings the legendary St. Regis lifestyle into an exclusive collection of homes. This exceptional address offers a curated range of layouts, from elegant one-bedroom residences to magnificent five-bedroom penthouses, including coveted half-floor and full-floor penthouse options. With generously proportioned interiors and a limited number of residences per floor, every home delivers a rare sense of privacy, space, and timeless sophistication.

Residents are treated to a remarkable array of world-class amenities designed to deliver five-star hospitality every single day. Wellness and leisure flourish with a stunning infinity swimming pool overlooking the skyline, a fully equipped gym, sauna and steam rooms, spa and massage suites, an outdoor yoga area, a running track, and a padel tennis court. For entertainment and connection there is a cinema room, a golf simulation room, a refined library, elegant lounges, a boardroom, and a dedicated kids' play area, all supported by 24-hour concierge, valet, and doorman services.

Inside, each residence showcases bespoke high-end finishing that reflects a truly artistic vision and impeccable craftsmanship. Beautiful natural stones and mesmerising marble create layered, contemporary interiors where smoky greys flow gracefully across crisp, refined backgrounds. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows fill every home with natural light, while thoughtful touches of greenery and premium materials complete interiors that epitomise effortless elegance and signature style.

##### Location description and benefits

Downtown Dubai is the vibrant heart of the city, renowned for its dazzling skyline and bustling urban atmosphere. This iconic district is home to some of the world’s most famous landmarks, including the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world, and the Dubai Mall, one of the largest shopping and entertainment destinations globally. The area seamlessly blends luxury, modernity, and tradition, offering a dynamic lifestyle for residents and visitors alike.

Downtown Dubai boasts a diverse array of dining, shopping, and entertainment options. From high-end boutiques to trendy cafes and gourmet restaurants, there’s something to cater to every taste and preference. The Dubai Fountain, with its captivating water and light shows, adds to the district’s allure, drawing crowds for its mesmerizing performances.

With its central location, Downtown Dubai provides easy access to other parts of the city, including the Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) and Dubai’s major highways. Whether it’s the allure of luxury living, the excitement of city life, or the proximity to world-class attractions, Downtown Dubai encapsulates the essence of urban sophistication and modern living.
